statements.subject: message
statements.description: The Contact header field values of the request typically consist of SIP or SIPS URIs that identify particular SIP endpoints (for example, "sip:carol@cube2214a.chicago.com"), but they MAY use any URI scheme.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Once a client has established bindings at a registrar, it MAY send subsequent registrations containing new bindings or modifications to existing bindings as necessary.
actions: send REGISTER containing new bindings or modifications to existing bindings

statements.subject: message
statements.description: If the address-of-record in the To header field of a REGISTER request is a SIPS URI, then any Contact header field values in the request SHOULD also be SIPS URIs.

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients should only register non-SIPS URIs under a SIPS address-of-record when the security of the resource represented by the contact address is guaranteed by other means.
